exact_switch_mechanism_determined.investigation_performed: Grepped src/core/main.py, src/core/pumpfun_curve_listener.py, src/core/creator_funding_worker.py, src/core/transfer_indexer.py, src/extractors/realtime_creator_funding_extractor.py, src/extractors/funder_incoming_extractor.py for DB_PATH / hardcoded database path resolution.
exact_switch_mechanism_determined.finding: Confirmed, consistent with R1's own restart_target_contract.json: ALL modules resolve their DB path as a module-level constant at process import time (e.g. src/core/main.py:47 DB_PATH = os.path.abspath(os.environ.get('DB_PATH', _DEFAULT_DB_PATH)); src/core/pumpfun_curve_listener.py:761-764; src/core/creator_funding_worker.py:69-71; src/extractors/realtime_creator_funding_extractor.py:57-59; src/extractors/funder_incoming_extractor.py:70). No module re-resolves the path lazily or via a live-reloaded config, so an already-running process would NOT pick up a new DB target without a full restart.
exact_switch_mechanism_determined.determined_mechanism: Smallest atomic reversible switch: (1) quarantine-rename the live file, e.g. `mv database/flex_complete_database.db database/flex_complete_database.db.pre_p5b_quarantine`, (2) rename the fully-delta-applied candidate into the exact original path, e.g. `mv database/_p5a_migration_build/replacement_main.db database/flex_complete_database.db`. Both are POSIX rename(2) calls within the same filesystem/volume, hence atomic (no partial-file window). Followed immediately by starting all 3 writer services in R1's proven order so they resolve DB_PATH fresh against the new file.
